title: Bill Gates Doom
summary: A short clip from Microsoft's 1995 Judgement Day event in which Bill Gates is inserted into Doom as a promo for Windows 95 and DirectX gaming. It was never publicly released at the time.
why: Cited mostly as a retro-tech curiosity about Microsoft's push into PC gaming, and sometimes as a joke.

quote.text: Bill Gates even appeared in the game in a DirectX promotional video.
